title: Watch Transformers: The Movie (1986) for Free This Weekend
content:
Just for this weekend, you can watch the 1986 animated classic Transformers: The Movie for free on YouTube, starting tonight at 8pm ET. The showing also includes a 2026 short film based on the movie called Optimus Prime: Awakening.

Transformers: The Movie was stacked with voice talent: Eric Idle, Judd Nelson, Leonard Nimoy, Casey Kasem, Robert Stack, and even Orson Welles, in his final film role. The movie didn’t do very well at the box office, but over time it’s become a bit of a cult classic. (via tim carmody)
